reponse: No salary has been offered to Yael Mizrahi yet — she was still in the hiring process as of November 17, moving to her final round with Maya Cohen scheduled for November 24 [1][3]. The team agreed to wait until after the finals before discussing numbers [4]. Yael hasn't given a figure, only saying she expects something "competitive with big tech" [4]. For reference, the Senior SRE compensation band is 520–600k ILS base in Tel Aviv or $170–190k in New York [2].
